from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484937/attempts/902a26a1d741414098c8ca31bef93000/system/state/workspace/programs')

file=p/'task-a26536d3.py'
file.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Separator rows and columns define rectangular cells. Mark cells containing
    # exactly two occurrences of the non-background marker.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = grid[0][-1] if False else None
    # Infer separator color from fully uniform rows and columns.
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 6]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != 6]
    # separators occur at regular boundaries; exclude them when splitting.
    rb = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    marker = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (6, 3))
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        row = []
        for x, y in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            n = sum(grid[i][j] == marker for i in range(a + 1, b) for j in range(x + 1, y))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else 6)
        out.append(row)
    return out
''')
print(file)
